adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed as `(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))`, which requires the user to be both a team admin and a team owner. This contradicts the variable name and typical authorization intent (admin OR owner) and will incorrectly deny access to team admins who are not owners (and are not the organizer/attendee) via the subsequent `FORBIDDEN` check.
